<a name="KeyIDPattern"></a>KeyIDPattern adalah regex untuk keyid \(64 karakter hex huruf kecil\)

```go
var KeyIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
```

<a name="PackagePattern"></a>PackagePattern adalah regex untuk nama paket

```go
var PackagePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$`)
```

<a name="Add"></a>
## func [Add](<https://github.com/sbimasena/Tugas3_IF4020_17/blob/main/internal/trust/store.go#L99>)

```go
func Add(store *contract.Store, entry contract.Entry, name string)
```

Add memberi kunci izin untuk paket name. Kalau keyid sudah ada di store, name ditambahkan ke Packages entry tersebut.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>



```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"kelompok17/internal/contract"
	"kelompok17/internal/trust"
)

func main() {
	var s contract.Store
	e := contract.Entry{KeyID: strings.Repeat("ab", 32), Algorithm: "ed25519"}
	trust.Add(&s, e, "demo")
	trust.Add(&s, e, "tools")
	fmt.Println(len(s.Keys), s.Keys[0].Packages)
	fmt.Println(trust.Remove(&s, e.KeyID), len(s.Keys))
	fmt.Println(trust.Remove(&s, e.KeyID))
}
```

#### Output

```
1 [demo tools]
<nil> 0
keyid not found
```

</p>
</details>

## func [Load](<https://github.com/sbimasena/Tugas3_IF4020_17/blob/main/internal/trust/store.go#L58>)

```go
func Load(path string, core contract.Core, create bool) (contract.Store, error)
```

Load membaca file di path lalu memanggil Parse. Kalau create true dan file belum ada, Load mengembalikan store kosong.

<a name="Parse"></a>
## func [Parse](<https://github.com/sbimasena/Tugas3_IF4020_17/blob/main/internal/trust/store.go#L24>)

```go
func Parse(data []byte, core contract.Core) (contract.Store, error)
```

Parse mem\-parse trust store dengan core.StrictJSON lalu mengecek setiap entry: keyid tidak dobel, algorithm didukung, PEM cocok dengan algorithm dan keyid, dan daftar paket tidak kosong serta tidak dobel

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>



```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"kelompok17/internal/core"
	"kelompok17/internal/trust"
)

func main() {
	_, err := trust.Parse([]byte(`{"schema":"minisign-trust/v1","keys":[]}`), core.Core{})
	fmt.Println(err)
	_, err = trust.Parse([]byte(`{"schema":"lain","keys":[]}`), core.Core{})
	fmt.Println(err)
}
```

#### Output

```
<nil>
invalid trust store schema or keys
```

</p>
</details>

## func [Save](<https://github.com/sbimasena/Tugas3_IF4020_17/blob/main/internal/trust/store.go#L71>)

```go
func Save(path string, store contract.Store) error
```
